displayTitle: LEGO Star Wars: Luke Skywalker's Galactic Adventures
synopsis: Join LEGO® Star Wars ™ Luke Skywalker on his legendary journey in a fun and interactive scrapbook-style guide - including an exclusive LEGO Star Wars minifigure. Relive the most memorable moments from the original trilogy with the Luke Skywalker minifigure that comes with the book as your guide! Visit iconic locations, meet LEGO Star Wars characters, find snippets of wisdom from Jedi Masters, and much more. Packed with fun, humorous scrapbook features, such as photos, notes, posters, tickets, and other memorabilia Luke has collected along the way. Join Luke Skywalker in an adventure across the galaxy: Full of fun facts and detailed images of real-life LEGO Star Wars sets, presented in an engaging way for young readers. The perfect gift for LEGO and Star Wars fans who want to learn more about the original trilogy of films and see some of the iconic locations and characters in LEGO form. Add to your LEGO collection with an official LEGO Star Wars Luke Skywalker minifigure! With engaging facts and imagery, this book is the perfect way for young fans to experience the LEGO Star Wars galaxy, and for existing fans to enjoy a fresh, humorous take on the epic saga. ©2026 The LEGO Group. © & ™ 2026 Lucasfilm Ltd.
